name: Anime Girl Hiding from Terminator
look: An anime-style drawing. A brown-haired girl with a red flower clip, blue dress and red shoes sits hugging her knees and crying behind an office cubicle wall. Behind her, a metal Terminator robot skeleton carrying a large gun walks into the office.
use: The crying girl is someone hiding from something they dread, and the Terminator is that thing hunting them down, like a deadline, a chore, a phone call or an awkward conversation.
slots: label on the Terminator: what is coming for you
label on the girl: who is hiding
examples: Me with my phone on silent
Me pretending I never saw the group chat
